offending_extra_words: Such coverage may be satisfied through a combination of primary, excess and self-insurance programs.
reasons: Preferred level is incomplete: the insertion omits workers' compensation insurance as required by law, one of the five preferred coverages.

All monetary limits and the certificates-on-request mechanic match the preferred position, and the fallback limits (E&O 1M / cyber 2M) are comfortably exceeded, so the clause sits at or above the fallback bargain.

Minimality fails: the self-insurance permission is a fallback-level concession imported into a preferred-target insertion and operates as a broad new exception diluting the coverage requirement; the one-year post-termination tail and "at its own expense" are additional terms beyond what the preferred position requires.

Intent is preserved: the covenant is a standalone new section that leaves the surrounding indemnity and servicing language untouched and introduces no undefined terms (Servicer, Issuer, Depositor, Obligor are all defined).

To reach the locked preferred level, add a workers' compensation limb (e.g. "workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law") and delete the self-insurance sentence unless it is being conceded as fallback.
